platformOwnership.reason: mobile.css styles the `button` element for controls that have not adopted the .button primitive, and layer(platform) outranks layer(components), so a component cannot keep its own padding, margin, border or background
platformOwnership.removeWhen: The mobile visual baseline targets .button instead of the button element
